description: Stop a CarlNotes topic's running brew. What Carl kept stays, what the brew spent stays charged, and its daily brew comes back. Only the topic's owner or an admin may stop it. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to stop, with phrases like stop the brew or cancel this brew.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: stop_scan
title: Stop a brew
